rules.title: San Francisco Rent Ordinance annual allowable rent increase (3/1/2026 - 2/28/2027)
rules.requirement: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable rent increase is 1.6% of the tenant's base rent for increases effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027. The prior period (March 1, 2025 - February 28, 2026) was 1.4%.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to rent-controlled units under the San Francisco Rent Ordinance, generally residential rental units in buildings with a first certificate of occupancy on or before June 13, 1979.
rules.exemptions: Applies only to rent-controlled units. The page does not list exemptions.
rules.interaction: Rent-controlled SF units are exempt from the state Tenant Protection Act cap (Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.12) because they are covered by local rent control.
rules.quoted_span: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
